project_sidewalk.why_rating: North Houston residential streets feature dedicated sidewalks leading toward retail centers. The moderate score reflects intermittent sidewalk discontinuities on secondary access streets and occasional surface unevenness from ground shifting, requiring attention during wet conditions.
